written.headline: Anthropic’s IPO faces valuation drop as growth slows and AI prices plunge
written.summary: Anthropic filed a Wall Street prospectus for a Nasdaq listing amid investor nervousness, noting that its quarterly growth fell from 145% to 45% and its valuation fell from $2 trillion to about $1.5 trillion. The filing warns of three risks: narrowing model differentiation, collapsing AI service prices and rising costs.

written.headline: OpenAI to purchase Google’s AI chips, seeks TPU optimization engineer
written.summary: OpenAI, a major Nvidia GPU buyer, is planning to buy Google’s Tensor Processing Units and has posted a job for an engineer to lead model optimization on the chips.

written.headline: ThinkWorld framework uses imagined world dynamics to improve robot learning
written.summary: The paper presents ThinkWorld, a Vision‑Language‑Action learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics using a Chain‑of‑Dynamics (CoD) representation and reinforcement learning with imagined futures. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate effective human‑to‑robot transfer and strong generalization to unseen tasks and environments.

written.headline: New controller PORTAL decides when to apply test‑time interventions
written.summary: Jiahao Zhang and co‑authors present PORTAL, a controller that decides when to use test‑time adaptation, which inputs to label, and when to stop querying, turning interventions that would lower overall accuracy into useful choices on selected batches.

written.headline: Delaware proposes AI-run companies, prompting congressional investigation
written.summary: Delaware is drafting legislation for an Artificial Intelligence Company that would let AI agents manage day‑to‑day operations, while owners could avoid liability. House Oversight Committee chair James Comer has asked the state for documents, citing concerns the model could shield powerful AI firms from responsibility.
